sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the invented nltl:TRF051_HullStructureShape IRI with a non-canonical shape IRI, and obtain/use the canonical plate-thickness property or path for the in-lieu deck/tank-top/tank-bottom/bulkhead branch; nltl:frameWebThickness cannot also stand for that distinct plate-thickness result. Constrain the in-lieu branch to the permitted structure alternatives and require adjacentFrameHeight to be positive before evaluating the instability formula, rather than allowing non-positive height to bypass that formula term.
